Create a scientifically corrected single prop reference and Tripo input, square 2048 by 2048 pixels. Retain the overall small cluster of nine cream/tan closed shells, realistic studio rendering, soft even lighting and elevated three-quarter camera. Correct every shell: Coenothyris are smooth oval to rounded biconvex lampshells with a short stout incurved beak and a small pedicle foramen; their surfaces have only subtle concentric growth lines, NO radial ribbing, NO strong median keel, NO scallop-fan outline. Make their upper and lower valves meet at the shell margin, not at a central face seam. Shells touch lightly at their bases to form a finite low cluster but each outline remains legible. Remove ALL sand, sediment, rock, rubble, ground texture and ground plane; no hardground slab or display plinth.
